about.text: Prepared in brick-shaped form, the color ranges from pale yellow to white, and it has a sweet and mild flavor when young, and matures into a strong ripe cheese with age. It is medium-soft, crumbles easily and is somewhat sticky to the knife.

sources.text: Wisconsin; washed curd, surface-ripened; young 2 weeks, mature 2-3 months typical
